title: Cute slime fuses with a magic crystal core
caption:
A slime just swallowed a magic crystal. Watch what happens.
A glowing blue slime splashes onto an ancient spellbook, swallows a dark crystal core, and fuses into a new being with a heartbeat of light.
Best on loop at night, when the soft glow and drifting sparkles feel the calmest.
If you could fuse with one magical object, which would you pick?
Follow @fruit_drama_tv for more tiny magical stories.
